entry.title: AIOU Diploma Programs 2026 – Complete Guide for Short Courses
entry.content:
AIOU Diploma Programs 2026 – Complete Guide for Short Courses

Complete guide to AIOU diploma and certificate programs 2026. Short courses duration 6 months to 1 year. Fast track your career skills without long degrees.

Why Choose Diploma Programs at AIOU?

Diploma programs are shorter than degrees (6-12 months). They focus on practical job skills. Perfect for working professionals and students who want quick qualifications.

Diploma Programs Offered by AIOU 2026

6-Month Certificate Courses

  • Certificate in Computer Applications (CCA)
  • Certificate in English Language
  • Certificate in Arabic Language
  • Certificate in Islamic Studies
  • Certificate in Early Childhood Education
  • Certificate in Food & Nutrition
  • Certificate in Graphic Design
  • Certificate in Digital Marketing

1-Year Diploma Programs

  • Diploma in Information Technology (DIT)
  • Diploma in Business Administration (DBA)
  • Diploma in Human Resource Management
  • Diploma in Marketing Management
  • Diploma in Banking & Finance
  • Diploma in Journalism
  • Diploma in Library Sciences
  • Diploma in Special Education
  • Diploma in Clinical Psychology
  • Diploma in Project Management

1.5 Year Post-Graduate Diplomas

  • PG Diploma in Educational Leadership
  • PG Diploma in TV & Radio Production
  • PG Diploma in Peace & Conflict Studies
  • PG Diploma in Gender Studies

Eligibility Criteria for Diploma Programs

Certificate Courses (6 months):
- Matric pass (minimum 33% marks)
- No age limit

Diploma Programs (1 year):
- FA/FSc/ICS/ICom pass (minimum 40% marks)
- Or equivalent qualification

Post-Graduate Diplomas (1.5 years):
- BA/BSc/BS pass (minimum 45% marks)
- Or MA/MSc (for advanced diplomas)

Diploma Fee Structure 2026

Certificate Courses (6 months):
Admission Fee: Rs. 2,000
Tuition Fee: Rs. 5,000
Exam Fee: Rs. 1,000
Total: Rs. 8,000

Diploma Programs (1 year – 2 semesters):
Admission Fee: Rs. 3,000
Tuition per semester: Rs. 4,000 × 2 = Rs. 8,000
Exam Fee: Rs. 2,000
Total: Rs. 13,000

Post-Graduate Diplomas (1.5 years – 3 semesters):
Admission Fee: Rs. 4,000
Tuition per semester: Rs. 5,000 × 3 = Rs. 15,000
Exam Fee: Rs. 3,000
Total: Rs. 22,000

How to Apply for Diploma Programs

Step 1: Visit admission.aiou.edu.pk
Step 2: Click "Diploma & Certificate Programs 2026"
Step 3: Select your desired program
Step 4: Fill application form
Step 5: Upload Matric/FA certificate
Step 6: Pay fee online or via challan
Step 7: Submit and save application number

Career Opportunities After Diploma

DIT Diploma: Computer Operator (Rs. 25,000-40,000), IT Support (Rs. 30,000-50,000)
DBA Diploma: Office Manager (Rs. 30,000-60,000), Admin Officer (Rs. 35,000-55,000)
Digital Marketing: Social Media Manager (Rs. 40,000-80,000)
HR Diploma: HR Assistant (Rs. 30,000-50,000)
Graphic Design: Freelance Designer ($500-2,000/month online)

Can You Upgrade Diploma to Degree?

Yes! Diploma credits can be transferred to degree programs:
- DIT diploma → BS Computer Science (1 year exemption)
- DBA diploma → BBA or BS Economics (1 year exemption)
- English certificate → BA English (exemption in 2 courses)

Frequently Asked Questions

Are AIOU diplomas recognized for jobs?

Yes, AIOU diplomas are HEC recognized and accepted for private sector jobs and government posts that require diplomas.

Can I do diploma without Matric?

No. Matric is minimum requirement for certificate and diploma programs.
📚 Related: Admission Guide | BS Program Guide | Fee Structure

entry.title: AIOU Code 1433 Solved Guess Paper 2026 | Islamic Studies | Assignmentwaly
entry.content:
📚 Assignmentwaly

Your AIOU Academic Excellence & Free Resources Hub

🕌 AIOU Code 1433 Solved Guess Paper 2026: Islamic Studies (Islamiat)

📅 Exam: Autumn 2026 🎓 Program: BA / B.Com / Associate Degree 📚 Subject: Islamic Studies (1433) 🎯 Target: 80%+ Marks
📢 Assalam-o-Alaikum, dear AIOU student!

I'm your academic tutor from Assignmentwaly. Islamic Studies (Islamiat) is not just a compulsory subject—it is the foundation of our faith, ethics, and way of life. Many students find it easy to score high marks if they focus on the core topics. After analyzing the last 5 years' AIOU past papers, the official syllabus, and current exam trends, I have prepared this comprehensive guess paper for Code 1433. This paper covers: Fundamental beliefs of Islam (Imaniyat), Pillars of Islam (Arkan-e-Islam), the Holy Quran, Hadith, Seerat-un-Nabi (ﷺ), Islamic economic system, human rights in Islam, and contemporary issues. Let's solve these important questions together, step-by-step, in simple English.

🔍 Pro Tip: Always practice with AIOU Past Papers. Our analysis shows that 70% of questions are repeated with slight variations.

❓ Question 1 (Long Question - 10 marks): Define Iman (Faith) in Islam. Explain the six articles of faith (Iman-e-Mufassal) in detail.

📌 Answer:

Definition of Iman (Faith): Iman is the firm belief and conviction in the heart, affirmed by the tongue, and acted upon by the limbs. It is the foundation of Islam. The Holy Quran says: "The believers are only those who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely" (Surah Al-Anfal, 8:2).

The Six Articles of Faith (Iman-e-Mufassal):

  • 1. Belief in Allah (Tauheed): The most fundamental article is belief in the Oneness of Allah. He is the Creator, Sustainer, and Master of the universe. He has no partner, no son, no parents. He is All-Powerful, All-Knowing, and Most Merciful. The Quran states: "Say, He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent" (Surah Al-Ikhlas, 112:1-4).
  • 2. Belief in Angels (Mala'ikah): Angels are created by Allah from light (noor). They are sinless, obedient, and invisible. They perform various duties: Jibraeel (AS) brought revelation, Mika'eel (AS) controls rain and sustenance, Israfeel (AS) will blow the Trumpet on Judgment Day, and Azra'eel (AS) takes souls at death. Two angels (Kiraman Katibeen) record every person's deeds.
  • 3. Belief in Divine Books (Kutubullah): Allah revealed holy books to various prophets as guidance for humanity. These include: the Torah (Tawrat) to Musa (AS), the Psalms (Zabur) to Dawud (AS), the Gospel (Injeel) to Isa (AS), and the final, complete, and unchanged revelation—the Holy Quran—to Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ). Muslims believe in all previous books but follow only the Quran as the final authority.
  • 4. Belief in Prophets (Rusulullah): Allah sent prophets to every nation to guide them to the right path. The first prophet was Adam (AS), and the last is Muhammad (ﷺ). There are 124,000 prophets according to Hadith, but 25 are mentioned in the Quran. Muslims believe in all prophets without discrimination. The Quran says: "We make no distinction between any of His messengers" (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:285).
  • 5. Belief in the Day of Judgment (Yawm al-Qiyamah): This is belief in the final day when all humans will be resurrected for accountability. On that day, every person will be judged according to their deeds. Those with good deeds will enter Paradise (Jannah), and those with evil deeds will be punished in Hellfire (Jahannam). Belief in the afterlife encourages righteous behavior and accountability.
  • 6. Belief in Divine Decree (Qadr): Belief that everything—good or bad—happens by the will and knowledge of Allah. Allah has preordained everything, including life, death, wealth, and poverty. However, humans have free will to choose between right and wrong, and they will be held accountable for their choices. The Quran states: "Indeed, all things We created with predestination" (Surah Al-Qamar, 54:49).
📖 Quranic Reference: "The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], 'We make no distinction between any of His messengers.'" (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:285)
❓ Question 2 (Long Question - 10 marks): Explain the five pillars of Islam (Arkan-e-Islam) in detail. What is the importance of each pillar?

📌 Answer:

Introduction: The five pillars of Islam are the foundation of a Muslim's faith and practice. Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) said: "Islam is built upon five [pillars]: the testimony that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; establishing prayer; giving Zakat; fasting Ramadan; and Hajj to the House (Kaaba)" (Bukhari & Muslim).

  • 1. Shahadah (Declaration of Faith): The first pillar is the declaration: "Ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Allah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan rasul-Allah" (I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah). This statement affirms the Oneness of Allah and the prophethood of Muhammad (ﷺ). It is the entry point to Islam. Importance: It distinguishes a Muslim from a non-Muslim and is the basis of all other acts of worship.
  • 2. Salah (Prayer): Muslims perform five daily prayers: Fajr (dawn), Dhuhr (noon), Asr (afternoon), Maghrib (sunset), and Isha (night). Prayer includes recitation of Quran, bowing (ruku), prostration (sajdah), and supplication (dua). Importance: Salah connects a Muslim directly to Allah five times a day, purifies the soul, prevents indecency and evil, and provides spiritual discipline. The Quran says: "Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing" (Surah Al-Ankabut, 29:45).
  • 3. Zakat (Almsgiving): Zakat is the compulsory charity of 2.5% of a Muslim's annual savings (wealth, gold, silver, cash, business assets) given to the poor and needy. It purifies wealth and helps reduce economic inequality. Importance: Zakat teaches compassion, generosity, and social responsibility. It is a right of the poor upon the rich. The Quran mentions Zakat alongside Salah many times, indicating its importance.
  • 4. Sawm (Fasting in Ramadan): Muslims fast from dawn to sunset during the month of Ramadan. Fasting means abstaining from food, drink, smoking, and sexual relations, as well as evil thoughts and actions. Importance: Fasting develops self-discipline, empathy for the hungry, spiritual purification, and gratitude to Allah. The Quran states: "O you who have believed, fasting has been prescribed upon you as it was prescribed upon those before you, that you may become righteous" (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:183).
  • 5. Hajj (Pilgrimage to Makkah): Hajj is obligatory once in a lifetime for every Muslim who is physically and financially able. It occurs during the 8th to 12th of Dhul-Hijjah. Pilgrims wear simple white garments (Ihram), perform Tawaf (circling the Kaaba), Sa'ee (walking between Safa and Marwa), stand at Arafat, and stone the devil. Importance: Hajj symbolizes unity, equality, and submission to Allah. It erases past sins and renews one's faith.
💡 Tutor's Advice: For 10 marks, explain each pillar with its Arabic name, description, and at least one Quranic verse or Hadith. Draw a simple diagram showing the five pillars as a building foundation—examiners love visual aids!
❓ Question 3 (Long Question - 8 marks): Write a detailed note on the importance and teachings of the Holy Quran.

📌 Answer:

Definition: The Holy Quran is the literal word of Allah, revealed to Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ) through the angel Jibraeel (AS) over a period of 23 years. It is the final and complete revelation, and it is preserved in its original Arabic text without any change.

Importance of the Holy Quran:

  • Primary Source of Guidance: The Quran is the ultimate guide for all humanity in matters of faith, worship, morality, law, economics, politics, and social relations. It provides solutions to every human problem.
  • Last and Complete Revelation: Unlike previous scriptures that were altered, the Quran remains unchanged. Allah Himself promised its preservation: "Indeed, it is We who sent down the Quran and indeed, We will be its guardian" (Surah Al-Hijr, 15:9).
  • Source of Law (Shariah): The Quran is the primary source of Islamic law. Together with the Sunnah of the Prophet (ﷺ), it forms the basis of Shariah, governing all aspects of a Muslim's life.
  • Spiritual Healing and Mercy: The Quran is a source of healing for spiritual and psychological ailments. It brings peace to the heart. Allah says: "And We send down of the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers" (Surah Al-Isra, 17:82).
  • Miracle of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ): The Quran is the greatest miracle given to the Prophet. Its linguistic excellence, scientific facts, historical accuracy, and prophecies prove its divine origin.

Major Teachings of the Holy Quran:

  • Tauheed (Oneness of Allah): The central message is that Allah alone is worthy of worship. No partners, no intermediaries.
  • Risalah (Prophethood): Belief in all prophets, especially Muhammad (ﷺ) as the final messenger.
  • Akhirah (Hereafter): Belief in the Day of Judgment, heaven, and hell.
  • Justice and Equality: The Quran emphasizes justice for all, regardless of race, color, or social status. "O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm for Allah, witnesses in justice" (Surah An-Nisa, 4:135).
  • Moral Virtues: Honesty, truthfulness, patience, forgiveness, humility, charity, and kindness to parents, orphans, and neighbors.
  • Prohibition of Evils: The Quran forbids shirk (polytheism), lying, cheating, murder, theft, adultery, alcohol, gambling, usury (interest), and oppression.
  • Human Dignity: "And We have certainly honored the children of Adam" (Surah Al-Isra, 17:70).
  • Knowledge and Reflection: The Quran repeatedly encourages learning, observation, and contemplation of the universe.
❓ Question 4 (Long Question - 10 marks): Discuss the concept of "Seerat-un-Nabi" (Life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ). Explain the key characteristics of the Prophet (ﷺ) as a leader, a teacher, and a role model.

📌 Answer:

Definition of Seerat-un-Nabi: Seerat refers to the life, character, conduct, and teachings of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ). It includes his biography, his sayings (Hadith), his actions, and his approvals. The Quran commands Muslims to follow the Prophet's example: "Indeed, in the Messenger of Allah you have an excellent example for whoever hopes for Allah and the Last Day and remembers Allah often" (Surah Al-Ahzab, 33:21).

Key Characteristics of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ):

  • As a Leader:
    • Truthfulness and Honesty: Even before prophethood, he was known as "Al-Amin" (the trustworthy). He never lied or cheated.
    • Consultation (Shura): He consulted his companions in matters of state and war, even though he received divine revelation. This teaches democratic leadership.
    • Justice and Equality: He treated all people equally, regardless of wealth or status. Once he said that if his own daughter Fatima stole, she would be punished.
    • Mercy and Forgiveness: After conquering Makkah, he forgave his worst enemies who had persecuted him for 13 years. This is unmatched in history.
  • As a Teacher:
    • Patience and Gentleness: He taught with kindness, never harshness. He said, "Make things easy, not difficult" (Bukhari).
    • Practical Demonstration: He taught by example. He prayed, fasted, gave charity, and interacted with people in front of his companions.
    • Use of Parables and Questions: He used stories and rhetorical questions to make concepts easy to understand.
    • Respect for Students: He listened attentively and never interrupted anyone. He would sit in a circle with his companions, treating everyone equally.
  • As a Role Model:
    • Worship and Devotion: He prayed at night until his feet swelled. He fasted regularly. He was deeply connected to Allah.
    • Family Life: He was an ideal husband and father. He helped with household chores, mended his own clothes, and treated his wives with kindness and respect.
    • Social Relations: He visited the sick, attended funerals, greeted children, and helped widows and orphans. He never rejected an invitation from the poor.
    • Business Ethics: As a merchant, he was known for fair dealings. He forbade cheating, hoarding, and false oaths.
    • Bravery and Patience: He faced persecution, boycotts, and wars with unwavering patience and trust in Allah. He never sought revenge.
🕌 Quranic Command: "And indeed, you are of a great moral character" (Surah Al-Qalam, 68:4). This verse summarizes the Prophet's (ﷺ) exemplary character.
❓ Question 5 (Long Question - 10 marks): Define Hadith. Explain the classification of Hadith (Sahih, Hasan, Da'if, Mawdu') and the importance of Hadith in Islamic law.

📌 Answer:

Definition of Hadith: Hadith refers to the sayings, actions, approvals, and descriptions of Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ). While the Quran is the word of Allah, Hadith is the practical interpretation and explanation of the Quran by the Prophet (ﷺ).

Classification of Hadith: Based on authenticity, Hadith is classified into four main categories:

  • Sahih (Authentic): A Hadith with a continuous chain of narration (isnad) consisting of upright and precise narrators, free from any irregularity or defect. Example: Most Hadith in Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim. These are used as primary sources of Islamic law.
  • Hasan (Good): A Hadith where the chain of narration is slightly less precise than Sahih, but still acceptable. The narrators may have minor memory issues but are not accused of lying. Example: Many Hadith in Sunan Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi. These can be used for legal rulings but with caution.
  • Da'if (Weak): A Hadith with a break in the chain or a narrator who is known to have a poor memory or is of questionable reliability. Da'if Hadith cannot be used as the basis for legal rulings but may be used for virtuous deeds or moral encouragement, with caution.
  • Mawdu' (Fabricated): A Hadith that is falsely attributed to the Prophet (ﷺ). It contains a known liar in the chain or contradicts established Quranic teachings. Mawdu' Hadith are completely rejected and cannot be used for any purpose.

Importance of Hadith in Islamic Law:

  • Explanation of the Quran: The Hadith explains the general verses of the Quran. For example, the Quran commands prayer but the Hadith explains the method, timings, and number of rak'ahs.
  • Source of Legislation (Second after Quran): The Quran itself commands Muslims to obey the Prophet: "And whatever the Messenger has given you, take; and what he has forbidden you, refrain from" (Surah Al-Hashr, 59:7).
  • Practical Implementation: Without Hadith, many Islamic practices (like how to perform Hajj, Zakat calculation, marriage contracts) would be incomplete.
  • Moral and Ethical Guidance: The Hadith provides detailed guidance on manners, social conduct, and personal development.
🎯 Examiner's Note: For full marks, mention the famous Hadith collections: Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abu Dawood, Sunan Tirmidhi, Sunan Nasa'i, Sunan Ibn Majah. Also, explain the difference between Hadith and Sunnah briefly.

⚡ Important Short Questions (Must Prepare for 5-Mark Each)

  • ✅ Q1: What is Tauheed? Explain its three categories (Rububiyyah, Uluhiyyah, Asma wa Sifaat).
  • ✅ Q2: Define Shirk. Differentiate between major shirk (Shirk Akbar) and minor shirk (Shirk Asghar).
  • ✅ Q3: Write a note on the importance of Zakat and its benefits for society.
  • ✅ Q4: What are the conditions for the validity of fasting? Who is exempted from fasting?
  • ✅ Q5: Explain the rights of parents in Islam with Quranic verses.
  • ✅ Q6: What is the Islamic concept of Jihad? Differentiate between greater Jihad (Jihad-e-Akbar) and lesser Jihad (Jihad-e-Asghar).
  • ✅ Q7: Describe the economic principles of Islam regarding prohibition of interest (Riba).
  • ✅ Q8: What are the human rights granted by Islam? Discuss the Farewell Sermon of the Prophet (ﷺ).
  • ✅ Q9: Write a note on the role of women in Islam: rights, responsibilities, and dignity.
  • ✅ Q10: Define Halal and Haram. Give examples of each in food, business, and social relations.
  • ✅ Q11: What is the importance of the Sunnah in Islamic law?
  • ✅ Q12: Explain the concept of accountability (Akhirah) and its impact on human behavior.
  • ✅ Q13: Write a note on the Islamic system of governance (Khilafah).
  • ✅ Q14: What are the major sins (Kaba'ir) in Islam? Give examples.
  • ✅ Q15: Describe the Islamic teachings on environmental protection and animal rights.
🎓 Final Word: These short questions cover the most frequently asked topics in AIOU Code 1433 exams. If you prepare these 15 topics thoroughly, you can easily secure 35+ out of 40 in the short-answer section.

entry.content:
📐 AIOU Code 248 | Mathematics - II | Assignmentwaly

AIOU Code 248 – Mathematics - II
Solved Guess Paper 2026 (Matric/SSC)

Last updated: April 12, 2026 – السلام علیکم! میں آپ کا ٹیوٹر ہوں Assignmentwaly سے۔ یہ گیس پیپر پچھلے 5 سال کے پیپرز اور نصاب کی گہری تحقیق کے بعد تیار کیا گیا ہے۔ تمام جوابات اردو میں اور امتحان میں لکھنے کے لیے بہترین طریقے سے تحریر کیے گئے ہیں۔ آئیے مل کر 80% سے زائد نمبر حاصل کریں!

📢 امتحان: خزاں 2026 | 🎓 پروگرام: میٹرک (SSC) | 📚 مضمون: ریاضی دوم (248) | 🎯 ہدف: 80%+ نمبر | 📝 اعلیٰ ریاضی کے تصورات

📥 Free Downloads – Code 248 Resources

Click the buttons below to download solved guess paper, sample assignments, and past papers prepared by Assignmentwaly.

📄 Solved Guess Paper 2026 (PDF) 📜 Past Papers 2019-2025 (PDF) 📖 Algebra & Formula Sheets ✅ Important Short Questions (PDF)

⚠️ یہ ڈیمو لنکس ہیں – براہ کرم اصل فائل URLs سے تبدیل کریں (Google Drive یا Dropbox)۔

❓ سوال نمبر 1: دو متغیری خطی مساواتوں کے نظام کو حل کرنے کے طریقے (حذف، اخراج، اور گراف) بیان کریں۔ درج ذیل مساواتوں کو حل کریں: 2x + y = 8 اور x - y = 1

📌 جواب:

🔹 دو متغیری خطی مساواتوں کو حل کرنے کے طریقے (Methods to Solve Linear Equations in Two Variables):

  • حذف کا طریقہ (Elimination Method): ایک متغیر کو ختم کرنے کے لیے مساواتوں کو جمع یا تفریق کیا جاتا ہے۔
  • اخراج کا طریقہ (Substitution Method): ایک مساوات سے ایک متغیر کی قیمت نکال کر دوسری مساوات میں رکھی جاتی ہے۔
  • گراف کا طریقہ (Graphical Method): دونوں مساواتوں کے گراف کھینچ کر ان کے مقطع نقطہ سے حل نکالا جاتا ہے۔

🔹 مساواتوں کو حل کریں: 2x + y = 8 اور x - y = 1

حذف کے طریقہ سے (By Elimination Method):

2x + y = 8 ...(1)
x - y = 1 ...(2)

مساوات (1) اور (2) کو جمع کریں: (2x + y) + (x - y) = 8 + 1 → 3x = 9 → x = 3

x کی قیمت مساوات (2) میں رکھیں: 3 - y = 1 → -y = -2 → y = 2

∴ x = 3, y = 2

❓ سوال نمبر 2: درجہ دوم کی مساوات (Quadratic Equation) کی تعریف کریں۔ درج ذیل مساوات کو حل کریں: x² - 5x + 6 = 0

📌 جواب:

🔹 درجہ دوم کی مساوات کی تعریف (Definition of Quadratic Equation):

درجہ دوم کی مساوات وہ مساوات ہے جس میں متغیر (variable) کی زیادہ سے زیادہ طاقت 2 ہو۔ اس کی عمومی شکل ax² + bx + c = 0 ہوتی ہے، جہاں a ≠ 0 ہو۔

🔹 x² - 5x + 6 = 0 کو حل کریں:

طریقہ 1: تجزی (Factorization):
x² - 5x + 6 = 0 → x² - 2x - 3x + 6 = 0 → x(x - 2) - 3(x - 2) = 0 → (x - 2)(x - 3) = 0
x - 2 = 0 یا x - 3 = 0 → x = 2 یا x = 3

طریقہ 2: درجہ دوم کا فارمولا (Quadratic Formula):
x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / 2a
یہاں a = 1, b = -5, c = 6
x = [5 ± √(25 - 24)] / 2 = [5 ± √1] / 2 = (5 + 1)/2 = 3 یا (5 - 1)/2 = 2
∴ x = 2, x = 3

📚 مزید حل شدہ مشقیں (Solved Practice)

الجبرا، سود، اعداد و شمار، اور ہندسہ کے مکمل نوٹس حاصل کریں۔

📐 Algebra Formula Sheet (PDF) 💰 Interest & Percentage Problems (PDF) 📏 Geometry Area & Volume Formulas

❓ سوال نمبر 3: الجبری اظہاریوں کو سادہ کریں: (1) (a + b)² (2) (a - b)² (3) a² - b²

📌 جواب:

  • (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² (مثال: (x + 3)² = x² + 6x + 9)
  • (a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b² (مثال: (x - 4)² = x² - 8x + 16)
  • a² - b² = (a - b)(a + b) (مثال: x² - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3))

🔹 مزید فارمولے (Additional Formulas):

  • (a + b)³ = a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³
  • (a - b)³ = a³ - 3a²b + 3ab² - b³
  • a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²)
  • a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²)

❓ سوال نمبر 4: تناسب اور فیصد پر مبنی مسائل حل کریں: (1) اگر 3:5 = 9:x ہے تو x کی قیمت معلوم کریں۔ (2) 500 میں سے 20% کتنا ہے؟

📌 جواب:

🔹 (1) 3:5 = 9:x

3/5 = 9/x → 3 × x = 9 × 5 → 3x = 45 → x = 15

🔹 (2) 500 میں سے 20%

500 کا 20% = (20/100) × 500 = (20 × 500) ÷ 100 = 10000 ÷ 100 = 100

❓ سوال نمبر 5: سادہ سود اور مرکب سود کے فارمولے لکھیں۔ 10% سالانہ شرح سے 2000 روپے کا 2 سال کا سادہ سود اور مرکب سود معلوم کریں۔

📌 جواب:

🔹 سادہ سود (Simple Interest):

S.I. = (P × R × T) / 100 = (2000 × 10 × 2) / 100 = 40000 / 100 = 400 روپے

🔹 مرکب سود (Compound Interest):

A = P(1 + R/100)ᵀ = 2000(1 + 10/100)² = 2000(1.1)² = 2000 × 1.21 = 2420 روپے
C.I. = A - P = 2420 - 2000 = 420 روپے

❓ سوال نمبر 6: درج ذیل اعداد 4, 7, 9, 12, 7, 15, 9, 7 کا اوسط (Mean)، میڈین (Median) اور موڈ (Mode) معلوم کریں۔

📌 جواب:

  • اوسط (Mean): (4+7+9+12+7+15+9+7) ÷ 8 = 70 ÷ 8 = 8.75
  • میڈین (Median): ترتیب: 4,7,7,7,9,9,12,15 → (7+9)/2 = 8
  • موڈ (Mode): سب سے زیادہ بار آنے والا عدد = 7

❓ سوال نمبر 7: دائرے کا رقبہ اور فریم کا فارمولا لکھیں۔ 7 سینٹی میٹر شعاع والے دائرے کا رقبہ اور فریم معلوم کریں۔ (π = 22/7)

📌 جواب:

  • رقبہ (Area) = πr² = (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 22 × 7 = 154 مربع سینٹی میٹر
  • فریم (Circumference) = 2πr = 2 × (22/7) × 7 = 2 × 22 = 44 سینٹی میٹر

❓ سوال نمبر 8: پائتھاگورس کے نظریے کی تعریف کریں۔ ایک قائمہ الزاویہ مثلث میں جس کے دو اضلاع 3 سینٹی میٹر اور 4 سینٹی میٹر ہیں، تیسرا ضلع معلوم کریں۔

📌 جواب:

🔹 پائتھاگورس کے نظریے کی تعریف (Definition of Pythagoras Theorem):

قائمہ الزاویہ مثلث میں، قائمہ کے سامنے والے ضلع (وتر) کا مربع، باقی دو اضلاع کے مربعوں کے مجموعے کے برابر ہوتا ہے۔ h² = p² + b²

🔹 تیسرا ضلع معلوم کریں:

h² = 3² + 4² = 9 + 16 = 25 → h = √25 = 5 سینٹی میٹر

❓ سوال نمبر 9: مربع، مستطیل اور مثلث کے رقبے کے فارمولے لکھیں۔ ایک مثلث جس کی بنیاد 10 سینٹی میٹر اور اونچائی 6 سینٹی میٹر ہے، اس کا رقبہ معلوم کریں۔

📌 جواب:

  • مربع (Square): رقبہ = a²
  • مستطیل (Rectangle): رقبہ = l × b
  • مثلث (Triangle): رقبہ = ½ × b × h = ½ × 10 × 6 = 30 مربع سینٹی میٹر

❓ سوال نمبر 10: مکعب اور مکعب نما کا حجم معلوم کرنے کے فارمولے لکھیں۔ ایک مکعب نما جس کی لمبائی 5 میٹر، چوڑائی 3 میٹر، اور اونچائی 2 میٹر ہے، اس کا حجم معلوم کریں۔

📌 جواب:

  • مکعب (Cube): حجم = a³
  • مکعب نما (Cuboid): حجم = l × b × h = 5 × 3 × 2 = 30 مکعب میٹر

⚡ اہم مختصر سوالات (Short Questions)

  • سوال 1: 2x + 3y = 12 اور x - y = 1 کو حل کریں۔ جواب: x = 3, y = 2
  • سوال 2: x² - 4x + 4 = 0 کو حل کریں۔ جواب: x = 2 (دو بار)
  • سوال 3: (x + 2)² کو پھیلائیں۔ جواب: x² + 4x + 4
  • سوال 4: 2:3 = 8:x میں x کی قیمت کیا ہے؟ جواب: 12
  • سوال 5: 300 کا 15% کتنا ہے؟ جواب: 45
  • سوال 6: 1000 روپے کا 10% سالانہ شرح سے 3 سال کا سادہ سود کتنا ہوگا؟ جواب: 300 روپے
  • سوال 7: اعداد 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 کا اوسط کیا ہے؟ جواب: 6
  • سوال 8: قائمہ الزاویہ مثلث میں وتر کا فارمولا کیا ہے؟ جواب: h² = p² + b²
  • سوال 9: دائرے کا رقبہ کا فارمولا کیا ہے؟ جواب: πr²
  • سوال 10: مکعب نما کا حجم کا فارمولا کیا ہے؟ جواب: l × b × h

📈 80%+ نمبر حاصل کرنے کے لیے تجاویز

  • پچھلے 5 سال کے پیپرز حل کریں: زیادہ تر سوالات پچھلے پیپرز سے آتے ہیں۔
  • پریزنٹیشن بہترین رکھیں: مارجن، انڈر لائن، اور سرخیاں استعمال کریں۔
  • فارمولے یاد کریں: الجبرا، سود، رقبہ، اور حجم کے فارمولے یاد رکھیں۔
  • مشق کریں: زیادہ سے زیادہ مسائل حل کریں۔
  • تصدیق کریں: ہر جواب کو دوبارہ چیک کریں۔

📌 مزید AIOU وسائل، حل شدہ اسائنمنٹس، اور گیس پیپرز کے لیے ملاحظہ کریں: Assignmentwaly – آپ کا تعلیمی معاون

entry.title: AIOU Application for Correction/Change of Address – Download Form & Complete Guide (2026)
entry.content:
AIOU Application for Correction/Change of Address – Download Form & Complete Guide (2026)

Important Warning! AIOU database me registered postal address par university ki taraf se degree dispatches, books bundles, roll number slips, aor tamam official correspondence bheji jati hai. Agar address ghalat ya purana darj hai, to tamam parcels return ho sakte hain ya ghalat location par chale jate hain. Foran update karwayin!
🚀 Assignmentwaly Premium Study Services – AIOU Spring 2026
✅ Solved Assignments (Handwritten or Typed) – Rs 600 Only
✅ Premium Guess Papers – Rs 150 | Bundle Combo – Rs 800
✅ Urgent 24-Hour Dispatch – +Rs 300 Only
📞 📲 Order on WhatsApp: 03702388998
Download Address Correction Form (PDF)

Official AIOU PDF. Print, fill with black ink, and submit to the Examinations Department.

📌 When is Address Change/Correction Required? (Tabdeeli e Pata)

Aapko darj-zail situations me address update application zaroor bhejna chahiye:

  • ✅ City Shift: Aap permanently kisi naye shehar ya province me shift ho gaye hon.
  • ✅ Spelling Ghalti: Mohalla, street, ghar number, ya pin code kisi bhi jagah ghalat darj ho.
  • ✅ Incomplete Address: Old address me ghar number ya sector missing ho jis ki wajah se courier delivery fail ho rahi ho.
  • ✅ CNIC Address Match: CNIC pe darj naya address AIOU record se match na karta ho.
  • ✅ Books/Degree Delivery Fail: University ke books ya degree package delivery attempts fail ho chuki hon.
Ahem Mashwara (Best Time to Apply): Degree printing, transcript dispatch, ya roll number slip release se kam az kam 2 se 3 mahine pehle address update application submit karein. Dispatch ho jane ke baad records change nahi ho sakte!

📝 Step‑by‑Step Procedure for Address Change

  1. Download & Print: Upar diye gaye green button par click kar ke official PDF download karein aur A4 print lein.
  2. Provide Accurate Information:
    • Apna mukammal naam, enrollment number, program aur semester darj karein.
    • Purana Pata (Old Address): Jo address AIOU records me ghalat ya outdated show ho raha hai bilkul waisa hi likhein.
    • Naya Pata (New Address): Ghar/flat number, mohalla/street, sector, shehar, district, aur postal pin code mukammal likhein.
    • Active mobile number aur email address bhi confirm karein.
  3. Gather Proof Documents:
    • Attested copy of CNIC (naye address wala agar update ho chuka ho).
    • Proof of new address: Electricity/Gas/Water bill (naye address par), Rent agreement (lease), ya local domicile certificate.
    • Province shift cases: Rs. 50/100 stamp paper par signed affidavit ke aap permanently shift ho gaye hain.
  4. Pay Processing Fee (If Required):
    • Active students: Rs. 0/- (Bilkul Free).
    • Post-degree updates: Rs. 200/- to Rs. 500/- token fee (fee grid niche hai).
  5. Submit Application Package:
    • Courier: Director of Examinations, Correction Cell, AIOU, Sector H-8, Islamabad – 44000.
    • In Person: Examination Department, Ground Floor, Admin Block, AIOU Main Campus, H-8 Islamabad.
    • Regional Office: Nearest AIOU regional center (forward karein ge).
  6. Get Stamped Acknowledgment: Return copy par receive stamp zaroor lein taakay proof record rahe.
  7. Follow Up: 15 se 30 working days baad LMS profile check karein ya examination department ko call karein.
Pro Tip (Double Confirmation): Physical form ke sath-sath LMS portal login karein aur "My Profile → Edit Address" section me bhi naya address update karein. Double update se delivery system dono databases me sync ho jata hai!

📋 Required Documents Checklist

  • ✅ Fully filled AIOU Address Correction PDF Form (downloaded above)
  • ✅ Attested copy of Student CNIC (new address wala preferred)
  • ✅ Proof of new address: electricity/gas bill or rent agreement
  • ✅ Copy of existing AIOU ID card or paid admission challan
  • ✅ Signed affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper (for inter-province shifts)
  • ✅ Original paid bank challan (if post-degree update fee applies)

💰 AIOU Address Change Fee & Processing Schedule

Update Category Processing Fee Resolution Time Output Channel
Active Student (Same City Minor Correction) Rs. 0/- (Free) 10 to 15 Working Days LMS Profile Update / SMS Alert
Active Student (Inter-City / Province Shift) Rs. 0/- (Free) 15 to 25 Working Days CMS + Books Dispatch Update
Post-Degree / Transcript Address Update Rs. 200/- to Rs. 500/- 20 to 30 Working Days Physical Verification Letter
New ID Card Reprint with Updated Address Rs. 300/- Challan 10 Working Days Dispatched by Standard Post
*Note: Active student address corrections are generally free. Confirm current rates with your regional office before any payment.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions – Address Update Support

🔹 Kya main sirf LMS portal se address update kar sakta hon?
LMS me profile update karna sirf contact record ke liye hota hai. Degree printing aur books dispatch ke liye official physical form submit karna compulsory hai, warna parcel dispatch nahi hoga.
🔹 Meri purani degree par naya address print ho ga?
Nahi. Jo degree ya transcript already print ho chuki ho, uska address change nahi hota. Sirf future documents naye address par issue honge. Agar existing degree ko update karwana ho, to Duplicate Degree form alag se bharna hoga.
🔹 Agar utility bill naye address par nahi hai to address proof kaise dein?
Agar bill nahi hai, to local rent agreement (baqa'ida sign shuda) ya Rs. 100 stamp paper par affidavit de sakte hain. Gazetted officer ki attestation bhi acceptable hai.
🔹 Address change request ka last date kya hai?
Koi fixed deadline nahi hai, lekin degree printing ya roll number slips dispatch se kam az kam 2 mahine pehle apply zaroor karein warna update dispatch cycle me apply nahi hoga.
🔹 Solved assignments, handwritten notes aur quick guidance ke liye direct contact kya hai?
AIOU ke kisi bhi code ki solve assignments (handwritten/typed scans), guess papers, aor administrative guidance ke liye hamare helpline WhatsApp 03702388998 par message karein. Email: faiezhafeez@gmail.com.
